limitations: uiautomator content-desc is the Android accessibility node text, not a spoken TalkBack pass.
Gorhom GestureSheet content is not exposed in the uiautomator tree; its steps were verified from screenshots.
Motion was verified from screenrecord frames; screenrecord only emits changed frames, so frame counts are not frame-rate measurements.
Host load average reached 54 during the run; swipe results in D6 were repeated to separate flakiness.
